description: Rory enters Chilton, drawing Lorelai back into regular contact with Emily and Richard while first love and the demands of elite schooling begin changing life in Stars Hollow.

s01e01.description: Rory’s acceptance to Chilton forces Lorelai to borrow tuition money from her estranged parents, who make weekly family dinners part of the deal just as Rory meets Dean.

s01e02.description: Lorelai’s disastrous arrival at Chilton embarrasses Rory, whose first day then introduces an intimidating workload and classmates determined to make the new girl feel unwelcome.

s01e03.description: Richard teaches Rory to play golf and unexpectedly bonds with her, stirring Lorelai’s insecurity while the Independence Inn struggles through an elaborate double wedding.

s01e04.description: After receiving the first poor grade of her life, Rory studies obsessively for a Shakespeare exam but oversleeps, misses the test and finally erupts under Chilton’s pressure.

s01e05.description: A neighborhood cat’s funeral brings Stars Hollow together while Lorelai and Max confront their mutual attraction and Rory’s relationship with Dean moves another step forward.

s01e06.description: Emily and Lorelai plan radically different birthday parties for Rory, exposing the gulf between their worlds before Emily and Richard attend the informal Stars Hollow celebration.

s01e07.description: Dean gives Rory her first kiss, but Rory hides it from Lorelai until Mrs. Kim reveals the news, prompting an awkward attempt to welcome Dean into their home.

s01e08.description: Stars Hollow’s first snowfall gives Lorelai and Max their first real date while Rory spends the evening with her grandparents and Lane resents Rory’s divided attention.

s01e09.description: Rory and Dean attend the Chilton dance and accidentally fall asleep afterward, sending Rory home at dawn and reigniting the worst assumptions between Emily and Lorelai.

s01e10.description: A tense Gilmore Christmas is interrupted when Richard collapses and is hospitalized, forcing Lorelai, Emily and Rory to put their recent conflicts aside while Luke quietly helps.

s01e11.description: Lorelai and Max are caught kissing at Chilton, and Paris spreads the story to deflect attention from her own family problems, leading Rory to offer unexpected sympathy.

s01e12.description: Lorelai is trapped on an awful double date with Jackson’s cousin Rune while Rory and Lane secretly arrange their own double date with Dean and Todd.

s01e13.description: Lorelai gives Rory three Bangles tickets to share with Chilton classmates, but Madeline and Louise abandon the concert for a party with strangers and trigger a frantic search.

s01e14.description: A debate over traditional domestic roles leads Rory to stage a 1950s dinner for Dean, while Lorelai’s growing closeness with Luke becomes harder to ignore and Christopher arrives unexpectedly.

s01e15.description: Christopher’s visit culminates in a disastrous dinner with both families and an impulsive proposal to Lorelai, who refuses because she doubts he is ready for family life.

s01e16.description: Luke’s former girlfriend Rachel returns to Stars Hollow as Dean celebrates three months with Rory, gives her a car and declares his love, leaving Rory unsure how to answer.

s01e17.description: Rory fills every minute to avoid grieving her breakup with Dean, but a party and an unexpected kiss from Tristan finally break through her determined denial.

s01e18.description: Richard’s formidable mother Trix arrives and offers Rory a trust fund, alarming Emily, while Paris learns that Rory encouraged Tristan to ask her on a date.

s01e19.description: Rachel discovers an abandoned inn that excites Lorelai and Sookie, while Rory gives Emily a tour of Stars Hollow that ends painfully at Lorelai’s former home.

s01e20.description: Rory learns that Lorelai and Max are dating again and runs to her grandparents after an argument, while Lorelai finally discovers why Dean ended the relationship.

s01e21.description: Rachel leaves after accepting Luke’s feelings for Lorelai, Rory reconciles with Dean and finally tells him she loves him, and Max proposes to Lorelai with a thousand daisies.
